[!IMPORTANT]
**Please edit the Issue Title at the top of this page!**
- **Milestone options:** `M1`, `M2`, `M3`, `M4`, `M5`, `Mn` (for unplanned/bug fixes)
- **Track options:** `FE` (Front-End React/UI), `BE` (Back-End Node/Mongo), `DTD` (DevOps, Testing & Docs)
- **Follow the Tempalte** `[BUG]: [{milestone}-{track}] {issue title}`

*Example title:* `[BUG]: [M1-FE] Fix navigation bar layout crash`
